source_html: 8.1.4 二重积分的积分次序(40题).html

questions.prompt_html: \text{设}f(x)\text{在}[0,4]\text{上连续，且}D:x^{2}+y^{2}\leq 4,\text{则}\iint_{D}f(x^{2}+y^{2})dxdy\text{在极坐标系下先对}r\text{积分的二次积分为} \left[ \quad\right].

options.label: A
options.html: \int_{\pi}^{2 \pi} d \theta \int_{0}^{2} f(r) r dr\,.

options.label: B
options.html: \int_{0}^{2 \pi} d \theta \int_{0}^{2} f ( r ^ { 2 } ) r d r \; ;

options.label: C
options.html: \int_{0}^{2 \pi} d \theta \int_{0}^{\cos \theta} f ( r ^ { 2 } ) r ^ { 2 } d r \, ;

options.label: D
options.html: \int_{0}^{\pi} d\theta \int_{0}^{1} f(r^{2}) r dr\, ;

questions.analysis_html: \text{解答} \quad \text{在极坐标下} \, 0 \leq \theta \leq 2 \pi , 0 \leq r \leq 2 , \text{所以} \iint\limits_{D} f(x^{2}+y^{2})dxdy = \int_{0}^{2 \pi} d\theta \int_{0}^{2} f(r^{2})rdr.

questions.prompt_html: \text{交换二次积分} \int_{0}^{1} dx \int_{x^{2}}^{x} f(x,y) dy \text{的积分次序，下列正确的是[ ].} \ast

options.label: A
options.html: \int_{0}^{1}dx\int_{x^{2}}^{x}f(x,y)dy\!=\!\int_{-1}^{1}dy\int_{y^{2}}^{y}f(x,y)dx\,;

options.label: B
options.html: \int_{0}^{1} dx \int_{x^{2}}^{x} f(x,y) dy \!=\! \int_{-1}^{0} dy \int_{y^{2}}^{\sqrt{y}} f(x,y) dx\,.

options.label: C
options.html: \int_{0}^{1} dx \int_{x^{2}}^{x} f(x,y) dy {=} \int_{-1}^{0} dy \int_{y}^{y^{2}} f(x,y) dx\, ;

options.label: D
options.html: \int_{0}^{1}dx\int_{x^{2}}^{x}f(x,y)dy\!=\!\int_{0}^{1}dy\int_{y}^{\sqrt{y}}f(x,y)dx\,;

questions.analysis_html: \int_{0}^{1} dx \int_{x^{2}}^{x} f(x,y) dy = \int_{0}^{1} dy \int_{y^{\sqrt{2}}}^{x} f(x,y) dx.

questions.prompt_html: \begin{array}{l} \text {设} f(x,y) \text {是连续函数，交换二次积分} \\ \int_{-a}^{0} dx \int_{-x}^{a} f(x,y) dy + \int_{0}^{\sqrt{a}} dx \int_{x^{2}}^{a} f(x,y) dy (a>0) \text {的积分次序} [ \quad]. \end{array}

options.html: \int_{0}^{a} dy \int_{-\sqrt{y}}^{\sqrt{y}} f(x,y) dx\, ;

options.label: B
options.html: \int_{0}^{a} dy \int_{-\sqrt{y}}^{y} f(x,y) dx\, ;

options.label: C
options.html: \int_{0}^{a} dy \int_{-y}^{\sqrt{y}} f(x,y) dx\,.

options.label: D
options.html: \int_{0}^{a} dy \int_{-y}^{y} f(x,y) dx\, ;

questions.analysis_html: \text{解答} \ \ \text{原式} = \int _ { 0 } ^ { a } d y \int _ { - y } ^ { \sqrt { y } } f ( x , y ) d x

questions.prompt_html: \text{交换二次积分} \int_{0}^{1} dy \int_{1-y}^{1+y^{2}} f(x,y) dx \text{的积分次序，正确的是[ }.

options.label: A
options.html: \int_{0}^{1} dx \int_{x-1}^{1} f(x,y) dy + \int_{1}^{2} dx \int_{\sqrt{x-1}}^{1} f(x,y) dy\ ;

options.label: B
options.html: \int_{0}^{1} dx \int_{1-x}^{1} f(x,y) dy + \int_{1}^{2} dx \int_{\sqrt{x-1}}^{1} f(x,y) dy\, ;

options.label: C
options.html: \int_{0}^{1} dx \int_{1-x}^{1} f(x,y) dy\,.

options.label: D
options.html: \int_{0}^{1} dx \int_{1-x}^{1} f(x,y) dy + \int_{1}^{2} dx \int_{\sqrt{1-x}}^{1} f(x,y) dy\ ;

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{解答 设积分区域}D_{x}\left\{\begin{matrix}1-y\leq x\leq 1+y^{2}\\0\leq y\leq 1\end{matrix}\right., \text{因此}D=D_{1}+D_{2}, \text{其中}\\&D_{x}\left\{\begin{matrix}1-x\leq y\leq 1\\0\leq x\leq 1\end{matrix},D_{2}\right.\left\{\begin{matrix}\sqrt{1-x}\leq y\leq 1\\1\leq x\leq 2\end{matrix}\right.,\\&\text{则故 原式}=\int_{0}^{1}dx\int_{1-x}^{1}f(x,y)dy+\int_{1}^{2}dx\int_{\sqrt{x-1}}^{1}f(x,y)dy\ldots\end{aligned}

options.label: D
